concerns.text: The plan claims to satisfy FR‑018 (obtain a verified joint SMILES + FQY dataset) by downloading a SMILES‑only parquet file. FR‑018 explicitly requires a *joint* dataset containing both SMILES strings and experimental fluorescence quantum yield values. Using a SMILES‑only source does not meet this functional requirement, even though the plan defers modeling steps. This constitutes a missing core requirement and violates the specification.
